_about: Every value the generator or the gate needs that is NOT in the provided datasheets. Each entry is marked ASSUMPTION with its reason. Datasheet values live in configs/gas/<device>/spec.json.

logging_interval_s.reason: Datasheets give no logging interval; 10 s as set in the task brief.

start_utc.reason: Arbitrary shift start; no real data to anchor to.

duration_s.reason: One 8-hour shift, as set in the task brief.

clean_air_baseline.reason: Normal air: no combustible or toxic gas, 20.9 %vol O2. Not from the datasheets.

measurement_noise_sd.reason: No noise specification given. Small Gaussian noise so clean air reads at or next to the baseline at the stated resolution. Not a field noise model.

alarm_setpoints.reason: Not in the provided datasheets. Placeholder of a typical order of magnitude; replace with the setpoint configured on the real device.

alarm_rule.reason: Brief: alarm = value >= threshold. For O2 the low alarm is a deficiency alarm, so it triggers at or below the setpoint. Alarms are modelled as non-latching (they clear when the value does).

exposure_limits.reason: Not in the provided datasheets. Placeholder of a typical order of magnitude; replace with the setpoint configured on the real device. STEL/TWA are only computed for CO and H2S.

value.pre_shift: samples before the shift start count as 0 (window always divided by its full length)

stel_rule.reason: Brief: STEL = rolling 15-min mean. How the first 15 min are handled is not specified; zero-fill chosen.

value.formula: sum(value * logging_interval) from shift start / 28800 s

twa_rule.reason: Brief: TWA = 8-h average. Computed as the accumulated dose divided by 8 h (the 8-h TWA of the shift so far), not as a mean over the elapsed time.

t90_s.reason: No response times given. Sensor response is modelled as first order with time constant T90 / ln(10).

recovery_factor.reason: Brief: the value falls more slowly than it rises. Fall time constant = 3 x rise time constant.

gas_mix.reason: Example mix from the task brief. VOC is not in the mix, so it stays at baseline during the bump test.

start_after_s.reason: Bump test at the start of the shift, 2 min after power-on.

gas_applied_s.reason: Test gas applied for 60 s, then removed.

count_per_shift.reason: Brief: 1-3 exposures per shift. Drawn uniformly.

gases.reason: Combustible and toxic gases (VOC on io6 only); O2 deficiency events are not modelled.

peak.reason: Peak levels drawn uniformly; ranges chosen so that some exposures cross the alarm setpoints.

plateau_s.reason: Duration at the peak level, drawn uniformly.

types.reason: Random exposures are always 'short'. The other types are placed only by the coverage plan: a sustained H2S exposure that crosses the 15-ppm STEL, a long CO exposure whose 8-h TWA crosses 25 ppm, and an LEL peak above the 100 %LEL range.

count_per_shift.reason: Brief: one SOS on the G8 in every shift. Independent of the gas readings.

state_values.reason: No state logging format given. pump_state is 'on' except during a pump fault; sos_state is 0/1.

event_label.reason: Ground-truth label written by the generator, not a device field. The gate uses it to check that every alarm has a cause.

value.model: linear drain over the datasheet runtime

battery.reason: Datasheets give runtime only. Battery starts full and drains linearly: pct = floor(100 - 100 * t / runtime). Over an 8-h shift that is 47 % (17 h) or 44 % (18 h).

signal_strength.reason: No signal specification given. Bounded random walk, one step per logging interval. Reported by every device.

bridge_link.reason: The G7x datasheet allows cellular and satellite links; how often a Bridge switches is not given. The link is cellular, with 1-2 satellite periods per shift.

value.marker: gap_before_s on the first row after a gap = seconds without rows (0 elsewhere)
value.data_during_gap: lost (not buffered); the device keeps measuring, so STEL/TWA still include the gap

connection_gaps.reason: Periods without rows, as from a lost connection. Each gap is announced on the next row so that the gate can tell an intended gap from a row lost to a bug. No gap during the bump test.

pump_fault.reason: No pump fault behaviour given. A fault sets pump_state to 'fault' and raises pump_alarm; the gas readings are not altered.

value.rule: item k goes to seed seeds[k + 1] (io6: seeds[k]); it replaces one random exposure (pump_fault is added on top). SOS is in every G8 shift.

coverage_plan.reason: The review asks that the 5-seed set contains each of: STEL alarm, TWA alarm, over-range, VOC exposure (io6), pump fault (io6), SOS (G8). Random draws do not guarantee that, so each item is placed on one seed. Seed 42 stays a plain random shift on every device except io6, which needs all five seeds.
